tool_args.rationale: The epidemic mobility bridge maps to the inland-hub siphon, but the five pilot observations vary only u_now. The open-branch probe can distinguish the branch and identify gradient dependence before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot holds s_grad fixed, leaving sink inhibition and the open branch insufficiently identified.
The bridge signature points first to a static siphon; trajectory measurements are more costly and not yet warranted.
They cannot establish the gradient dependence indicated by the bridge and flux-conservation signatures.
